messages:
ria: hey all :wave: first-week question — trying to run the sample infra PR but the Buildkite step that calls GitHub Actions via repo_dispatch returns 403 Forbidden. snippet:

```
POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/payments/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

I can see the repo in GH and the pipeline in Buildkite. anyone know who manages the Buildkite GH App install? @dom @ops-jen

dom: welcome! :tada: that 403 usually means the Buildkite GitHub App is installed in "selected repositories" mode and the target repo isn't included, or the token is a user PAT without the right scopes. can you paste the pipeline step that makes the request?

ria: here's the exact step from infra/pipelines/payments.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -s -X POST \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
      -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/payments/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \
      -d '{"ref":"main"}'
```

ops-jen: infra-bot checking org installs now... Buildkite GitHub App is installed but in "selected repositories" mode; payments is NOT included. adding it now. note: if your GH account hasn't completed org SSO we block some actions — have you completed SSO?

ria: i did 2FA but not SSO yet, doing that now. thanks for the heads up.

infra-bot: added `payments` to Buildkite app allowed repositories. propagation ~30s. tagging @ops-jen for rerun.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/9001 re-run requested by ops-jen

ria: re-ran after SSO and the repo_dispatch now returns 204, GH Actions queued. :raised_hands: thanks everyone!

dom: onboarding note: please open a tiny PR to infra/permissions.md listing repositories that need the Buildkite app for repo_dispatch, and move the curl into scripts/dispatch.sh with `curl -w "%{http_code}"` to log status codes. also request `ci-admins` team access via #people-ops.

ria: will do — i'll file the PR and tag you. super helpful, thanks!
